artboards.title: Register — history and whether it worked
Behind the "i" — every rule, off the surface

annotations.text:
The brief

Worth telling was folded into Follow-ups and the result was assembled, not designed: the retired page arrived as a third tab.

Redrawn from first principles — fewer words, one place to work, everything findable.

What was wrong

1. Prose walls — nine grey lines on the reference tab, two more in the rules panel, eight under the picture.

2. Duplication — a row read “Christine · Worth telling” and then a meta line beginning “worth telling”.

3. Dead figures — an em-dash over the basis “worth a word”.

4. Wasted canvas — the bottom-right 40% was empty grey.

5. A moving header — the strip was on two views, absent on the third.

6. Three levels of navigation stacked in the top third: tabs, six chips, a search.

7. An unactionable list — six of 116 names for a stage that is set on the client's own record.

What changed

Two views, not three: Work | Register. The five-tile strip is identical on both, so the furniture stops moving.

The strip IS the filter. Clicking Money filters the queue — the six chips are gone, and the tile you pressed carries the only underline.

Row rule: the chip names the kind, the figure and basis carry the number, the meta says only what neither has said. No word twice in a row.

The em-dash rows now read a real figure — the client's usual order, or “never / bought from you”.

Every disclaimer moved behind the “i”. One exception stays on the surface: Money / not counted, because a figure withheld has to say so where the figure would have been.

Reference has a home, not a tab

The register is the history; the score measures it. Pairing them fills the 304px rail, so nothing is empty grey — and “Site stage on file” is one line with a figure, not 116 names you cannot act on.

The phone is its own design, not the desktop reflowed

Five tiles become a 2×2 fold. Rows become buttonless cards — the whole card is the tap. Send is full-width and last, inside the thumb zone, and it is the only accent on the screen.

Every control clears 44px.
